WOWHEAD HAS FLIPPED TO SEASON 2. All 6 pages fetched live with the full browser header set (a UA-only fetch is 403), HTTP 200, 73-322 KB; tier data parsed from the WH.markup payload ([tier-list=rows] / [tier-label] / [spec-badge=<slug>]), 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched. Every <title> now reads "... for Midnight Season 2" (was Season 1 yesterday) and the bodies are explicitly 12.1: "Wowhead's DPS Tier List for the Venomous Abyss in Midnight Season 2 ... based on their survivability, utility, and damage output in Patch 12.1", with per-spec notes citing the 12.1 PTR cycle. This is NOT the patch going live (12.1 ships 08-11; these are pre-launch Season-2 predictions) — it is a LIVE-era source publishing next-season lists early, which DECISION 1 covers: seasonVerified is stored as s2, so consensusFor drops Wowhead from the 12.0.7 consensus in both brackets while its column, its letters and its projection input remain. 49 of 80 letters moved with the rebuild (raid 29, M+ 20), which is a new list rather than a retune and is why the letters are stored as fetched. Page-own JSON-LD dateModified is 2026-08-08 on all six (was 2026-04-19 to 2026-08-05) and agrees with published-evidence/evidence.json 6/6 — the independent pre-agent probe saw the same rebuild. Effect on the tracker: the live consensus is now a consensus of 3 (Icy Veins, Method, Archon) and 16 consensus letters moved one band each; 0 two-band moves and 0 coverage losses, so the anomaly gate is not breached.

Survivability is a death-rate cluster, not a rating; nothing here feeds the letter consensus.
